description.value: The Ferry Building Gallery is a public community art gallery housed in a heritage building over 100 years old at Ambleside Landing in West Vancouver, operated by the District of West Vancouver. The building began as a bustling ferry terminal and now presents up to 11 exhibitions annually featuring regional artists from the North Shore, Sea-to-Sky Corridor, and Sunshine Coast. Cyclists exploring the Ambleside waterfront will find a welcoming cultural stop with rotating juried and invitational exhibitions and a gift shop stocked with works by local BC artists.
